'''Halsta Labiqon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Jedi Consular]] who visited the town of [[Raider's Cove]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Halsta Labiqon appears as a consular trainer in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
